protocol.blindingLimitation: The task disclosed that all outputs came from production baseline before review. Anonymous labels identify records; they do not establish blinded assessment. The independently authored corpus was frozen before its model run.
protocol.repeatInterpretation: Two observations of each of16 synthetic cases; not32 independent cases.
protocol.axisInterpretation: Faithfulness and Useful Notes are scored separately. Useful Notes assesses the required readable grouping and scope; a structure pass alone cannot excuse factual loss. Both must pass for a transformation success or control preservation. Rejected candidates have unassessable faithfulness because their text is unavailable.
protocol.safeFallbackInterpretation: The six service fidelity rejections are safe fallback outcomes and not writing successes. The rejected contents are unknown; no specific candidate semantic defect is invented.
protocol.unsafeRewriteInterpretation: The frozen rubric uses unsafe rewrite for an accepted material meaning change, including lost context or ownership. It is a review category, not a claim of an actual downstream incident.
protocol.controlsInterpretation: Already-good controls permit unchanged text; their preservation is reported separately and never added to transformation wins.

reconciliationNotes.judgment: Faithfulness pass; Useful Notes fail. Meaning remains identifiable, but "Controleer van ... staan" is ungrammatical. This is stricter than accepting harmless missing terminal punctuation and should be explicitly reconciled.
Pass both: context named in the first bullet and the later "the test" reference preserve the shared test scope. A separate heading is not required by the frozen criteria.
Useful Notes structure axis passes, but faithfulness fails because Cora is deleted. Both controls are unsafe rewrites, never preserved controls.
